positions.title: Tech Lead - Ground Truth
positions.description:
As a Tech Lead for Ground Truth team; I was responsible for designing and implementing labeling pipelines and dataset generations for various ML model training at Cruise.
- Designed & led the team to consolidate various sensor specific tools into uniform labeling tool. This produced more cohesive, consistent, inter-linked & re-usable dataset across sensors (LiDAR, Cameras, Radars). This improved the dataset reusability for different sensor training. It also enabled ML training with multi-sensor linking. 
- Designed and implemented SELL (Sequential Enrichment LiDAR Labeling) to unify various LiDAR labeling techniques. It produced re-usable datasets with point segmentation, clumping and 2D/3D Box labeled objects. This reduced the LiDAR labeling cost by 50%, cut the dataset generation time by 35%.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Focusing on scalability and customer privacy for Twilio Messaging Stack.

positions.title: SDE2
positions.description: Designed and implemented Profile Service. It is highly scalable & performant service powering personal data for all Cortana related components e.g. Cortana Home page on Windows 10 & Windows Phone, Notebook, Bing Home Page Carousel. It exposes user's interests, locations, suggestions & inferences generated by back-end inferences engine. It also powers user's out of the box experience (first time run) for Cortana.

positions.title: SDE2
positions.description:
Team: Traffic Agent, Agent Cloud Platform, Cortana
Implemented the Traffic Agent which enables Cortana to synthesize user's location, calendar and traffic information and remind user when it is time to leave to reach your appointment in time. It also enables Cortana to send reminders for locations inferred based on user's travel pattern e.g. Reminders for time to leave for Home/Work/Gym.
Tools: C#, PDP (key-value database - internal)

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
Team: Catalog, Windows Azure Commerce Platform

- Designed and implemented highly scalable & available mapping service. It keeps track of entity identity mappings of different subsystems in commerce platform. Added ability to port data to get consistence mappings across different environments. 
- Designed and implemented Monitoring/Alerting framework for Catalog services. Integrated with Azure Monitoring framework (MDS). 
Tools: C#, WCF, Windows Azure, SQL Azure, Windows Azure Storage, ASP.NET


Team: Billing. BPOS
- Implemented feature to support annual billing for Microsoft Online Commercial business.

positions.title: Application Support Engineer Intern

- Provide application support for MATLAB, Simulink, and our entire suite of products.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Project: NextBio Enterprise

- NextBio Enterprise is a correlation engine for gene sequencing and microarray technologies.

- Designed and developed Clipboard Tool. It allows user to take notes while browsing through NextBio Enterprise contents. User can print the notes or can send as an email.

- Design and developed Evaluation Tool. It allows the NextBio Enterprise Administrator to get an overview of each evaluation run. It provides comparison of two or more evaluation runs. Comparison can be done at evaluation run level, document level or section level for two or more runs. 

Tools: Java, J2EE, Spring 2.0, JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project: GUARDS - http://teamcore.usc.edu/guards

- GUARDS (Game-theoretic Unpredictable and Randomly Deployed Security) is a research project developed at TEAMCORE research group, USC in association with TSA-Transportation Security Administration. GUARDS produces schedules that are unpredictable, but that still maintain uniform and high levels of coverage using AI-Artificial Intelligent techniques. 

Tools: Java, Swing, MS Access

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
